description: This PHP class defines and manages attribute collections for the HTMLPurifier library, handling internal expansion, inclusion processing, and identifier expansion for attribute types.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrCollections
classes.description: Handles storage, expansion, and inclusion of attribute collections within the HTMLPurifier framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the attribute collection object by performing setup via doConstruct.

methods.name: doConstruct
methods.description: Loads extensions from modules, processes inclusions, and expands identifiers for attribute collections.

methods.name: performInclusions
methods.description: Performs all inclusions specified within an attribute collection to merge additional attributes.

methods.name: expandIdentifiers
methods.description: Replaces string identifiers in attribute definitions with actual attribute objects, utilizing the HTMLPurifier_AttrTypes instance.
